name: CLI-Anything
description: "CLI-Anything: Making ALL Software Agent-Native" -- CLI-Hub: https://clianything.cc/
one_liner: Automatically builds a command-line remote control for any piece of software, so an AI agent can operate it the way a person would click through buttons and menus.
buyer: A software vendor who wants their product to work with AI agents like Claude Code or Cursor without hand-building an integration.
business_use_cases: A SaaS company generates a CLI for their own product so customers' AI agents can automate tasks inside it, turning it into a sales differentiator.
An agency that modernizes legacy enterprise software uses it to agent-enable desktop apps nobody wants to rewrite.
A marketplace (the project's own CLI-Hub) charges vendors to list a verified, agent-ready CLI for their product.

money_ideas.idea: Charge software vendors a listing/verification fee to get their generated CLI featured on CLI-Hub.
Offer paid custom-CLI-generation consulting for companies with complex proprietary software.

steal_this: Pick one popular desktop app that has no API, generate a clean CLI for it this weekend, and publish it to CLI-Hub to claim the first listing.
